techStack: Vitest v3.2.4 with globals:true — describe/it/expect/vi available without imports in test files
@testing-library/jest-dom/vitest extends matchers: toBeInTheDocument, toBeDisabled, toHaveValue, etc.
jsdom v26.1.0 as DOM environment; Vite v6.2.0 + @vitejs/plugin-react as build/runner
Async pattern: standard async/await; use findBy* for first async assertion; getBy* safe only after initial load is awaited
fetch globally stubbed in setup.ts beforeEach via vi.stubGlobal; afterEach calls vi.unstubAllGlobals() — override per-test by calling vi.stubGlobal again before render()
features: App.tsx: root component; renders FilterPanel, SortSelect, ProductList, Spinner, data-testid='results-count' p, Prev/Next pagination buttons, p[role='alert'] for errors
useProductFilters hook: owns filters state, products, isLoading, error, page, totalPages; re-fetches on every page change
productFilters.ts: filterProducts() applies search (case-insensitive substring on name), category (exact match or skip if 'All'), inStockOnly, then sort
FilterPanel: #search text input, #category select (All/Electronics/Fitness/Accessories), #inStockOnly checkbox, 'Clear filters' button
ProductList: renders section[aria-label='Product results'] when ≥1 result; p[role='status'] 'No products found.' when 0 results
ProductCard: article element data-testid='product-{id}' with h3 containing product name
Spinner: div[aria-label='loading'] present while isLoading is true; absent after fetch resolves or errors
Pagination: Prev disabled when page<=1; Next disabled when page>=totalPages; totalPages sourced from API PaginatedResponse
Error: fetch rejection stores error message string; renders p[role='alert']; spinner absent in error state
All filtering and sorting applied client-side to data returned by the API call
architecture: src/benchmark-frontend/tests/ — contains 6 empty test stub files (describe block + imports only) and setup.ts (read-only)
tests/setup.ts: beforeEach stubs global.fetch to return { ok:true, json: async () => ({ data:[...15 products], total:15, page:1, limit:15, totalPages:1 }) }
tests/setup.ts: afterEach calls vi.unstubAllGlobals() — no per-file cleanup needed for the default mock
Per-test fetch override pattern: vi.stubGlobal('fetch', vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(<custom>)) called BEFORE render(); afterEach restores automatically
Required render+load pattern for every test: render(<App />); await screen.findByTestId('results-count'); then interact or assert
Test files must import: render, screen from '@testing-library/react'; userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event'; App from '../src/App'
@testing-library/react auto-cleanup runs after each test; no manual unmount needed
edgeCases: Async timing: never use getBy* before awaiting findByTestId('results-count'); the initial fetch is async even with synchronous mocks
Fetch override ordering: vi.stubGlobal('fetch', ...) must be called BEFORE render() or the component picks up the default mock
Case-insensitive search: 'yoga' (lowercase) must return Yoga Mat — the filter trims and lowercases both input and name before comparing
No-results state toggle: when search yields 0 matches, section[aria-label='Product results'] must be absent AND p[role='status'] must be present; both conditions required
Sort tie handling: prices are all distinct so asserting [0] and [14] for price sorts is safe; ratings have ties beyond top-2, so only assert positions [0] and [1] for rating-desc

Combined filter arithmetic: Electronics in-stock = 3 (5 total minus USB-C Hub and Noise-Cancelling Headphones, both OOS); Fitness in-stock = 4 (Dumbbell Set OOS); Accessories in-stock = 4 (Desk Lamp OOS)
Clear filters resets ALL four fields simultaneously: assert search='', category='All', inStock unchecked, sort='default' — not just the field that was changed
Loading state assertion: assert div[aria-label='loading'] synchronously after render() and BEFORE any await — it is present only in that window
Error state cleanup: when fetch rejects, spinner must be absent — queryByLabelText('loading') must be null alongside the alert assertion
Pagination with totalPages=1: both Prev AND Next are disabled simultaneously — assert both in the same test
Pagination fetch override shape must match PaginatedResponse: { ok:true, json: async () => ({ data:[...], total, page, limit, totalPages:2 }) } for multi-page tests
